subject: english
title: Unit 1 Grammar 1 App
subtitle: Leo's companion to the Grammar 1 slides: 12 tabs replay the deck's own games with be going to — the prediction and weather note cards, the six rule games, the Error Hospital, SB p. 12, Dad's weather report, Activity 3, clue-to-prediction rounds, the quiz and a Dribble! soccer round.

content: Replay each Grammar 1 slide game on his own, with the slides' own sentences.
Make weather predictions from a clue, and tell a prediction from a plan.
Ask yes/no questions with be going to and give short answers.
language: Use be (am / is / are) + going to + base verb, including negatives.
Use the words from the slides: a prediction, and the eight weather note cards (blizzard, tornado, thunderstorm, heat wave, hurricane, sandstorm, drought, ice storm).
Complete the quiz with at least 80%.
